messages:
ana_sales: Hey team, Tony from Polaris wants a POC to validate SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and RBAC group mapping before committing. They specifically asked about an encrypted-assertion flow and whether we can run a staging cutover with private peering. Can someone scope? cc @rohan_se @lee_security

rohan_se: I can take the tech lead. Need answers: expected daily active users, peak auth TPS, typical SCIM patch frequency, and whether they expect SCIM to provision groups or just users. Also: which NameID do they prefer (email/opaque)?

tonY_customer: we have ~120k users, DAU ~60k, peak TPS ~55/s, SCIM delta every 2 minutes for role changes, and yes we push groups via SCIM. NameID should be email. We also require Encrypted Assertions + assertion signing.

lee_security: Security side: we'll need to fill their security questionnaire. Key items: customer-managed KMS support, HSM for signing keys, audit log retention (default 90d, can extend), SOC2 + ISO27001 statements. On SCIM over private peering: we support VPC peering for Private deployments; Hosted goes over TLS with IP allowlist.

mira_pm: For the cutover runbook I suggest: 1) dry run with 500 users, 2) canary 1k users, 3) full 2-hour staged switchover. If they want private peering we need network setup 5-7 days in advance. Also note DB migration isn't needed for SCIM-only flow but we do need to pre-populate role mappings.

rohan_se: Sample mapping snippet to test RBAC: ```yaml
saml:
  nameid: email
  acs: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs
attribute_mapping:
  groups: user.roles
  department: user.department
scim:
  bulk_endpoint: https://acme.scim/api/v2/Users
  patch_interval_seconds: 120
```
Share IdP metadata and a SCIM sample payload with group objects and role attributes.

ana_sales: Pricing question from customer: what is the delta between running the POC on Hosted (burst) vs a short Dedicated reservation for a 4-hour window plus a 30-day dev sandbox? Also they asked for a per-100k-auths estimate for Hosted auth+SCIM volume.

infra_ops: Pricing / ops note: Dedicated commit for this tier ~ $55k/mo. Short reservation pro-rate for 4h = monthly_commit*(4/720) + reservation fee (~$250). Hosted auth pricing rough: $0.0007/auth for auth+SCIM combination at scale; per-100k-auths ~= $70. These are marketing ballparks; legal/commercial will formalize in quote.

tonY_customer: Can you also include cost impacts if we enable assertion encryption and extra audit retention? Legal will require longer retention for 1 year.

lee_security: Encrypted assertions don't change pricing materially. Audit log retention to 1 year is an add-on; approx +$1k/month for extended retention on Hosted; on Dedicated/Private we can meet with on-prem storage or S3 lifecycle controls. I will prepare the security questionnaire answers but need their security POC contact and deadline.

tony_customer: contact is secops@polaris.example.com, deadline is next Friday EOD. We do include employeeIDs in SCIM attributes (not SSNs).

rohan_se: Action list: 1) Polaris -> send IdP metadata, SAML cert, and SCIM sample payloads (Tony). 2) Rohan -> build test mapping and run dry-run harness once payloads arrive. 3) Lee -> fill security questionnaire and prepare dataflow diagram + KMS controls. 4) Infra -> confirm Dedicated test node availability and lead-time. 5) Ana -> prepare tentative quote and Hosted-per-100k estimate.

infra_ops: We can spin a Dedicated test node but require 72h lead time and signed trial agreement. VPC peering requires netops approval and 5 business days. If they can't do peering we can set up an IP allowlist + mutual TLS for SCIM.

mira_pm: Proposed dates: dry-run Tue 10:00-11:00 PT, canary Wed 10:00-11:00 PT, full cutover Thu 09:00-13:00 PT. Tony, please confirm availability. I'll publish a short prerequisites checklist (IdP metadata, SCIM creds, test org URL, admin account) once dates lock.

tonY_customer: Dates look okay, confirm on Monday but tentatively good. We'll get metadata to you within 48h.

ci-bot: [notice] trial-request created: ticket TRIAL-9987. Please attach signed trial agreement.

ana_sales: Thanks all. I'll send a compact runbook and the preliminary quote after we get the IdP/scim payloads. Closing with action items; will follow up in calendar invite.
